decision_conditions: The proposed vehicular access arrangement cannot be accommodated due to the presence of the existing street tree and therefore constitutes an unacceptable form of access. Furthermore, the overprovision of car parking would fail to promote sustainable travel patterns and would be detrimental to the safe and efficient operation of the highway network. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy T6 of the London Plan (2021), Policies CP24 and CP25 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD45, DMD46 and DMD47 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

In the absence of an Arboricultural Impact Assessment and adequate details demonstrating that the proposed works would not adversely affect the street tree, the Local Planning Authority cannot be satisfied that the proposal would safeguard the health, longevity and public amenity value of the tree. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies G7 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010), DMD 46 and 80 of the Enfield Development Plan (2014), and the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
description: Variation of condition 2 of approval 24/04143/FUL to allow a new vehicular crossover.
